name: Ningbo Peacebird Fashion Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Peacebird Fashion Co.,Ltd. operates as a customer-centric fashion brand retailer in China. The company offers women's, men's and children's clothing products under the PEACEBIRD WOMEN, PEACEBIRD MEN, Mini Peace, LEDIN, and other brand names. It also retails and wholesales clothing and accessories; manufactures feathers; and offers technical development, consulting, exchanges, transfer, and promotion services.
